objective: Preallocate scan data keys from table and row-id lengths.

tasks.title: Preallocate scan data keys
tasks.result: Single-table scan hot paths now build data keys through an explicit-capacity helper instead of format!.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The scan data-key helper reserves exactly enough capacity for data:<table>:<row_id>.
The optimization replaces format! in vector-search row fetch, primary-key point lookup, small index result fetch, concurrent index result fetch, and row-cache insertion after stream fetch.
Generated key bytes, row-cache keys, storage lookups, key-only projection, vector result fetch, index fetch ordering, row decoding, and SQL results are unchanged.
An initial cargo fmt --check reported one formatting diff; cargo fmt was applied and the check passed afterward.
